children: DiamondRock Hospitality posted an investor presentation highlighting 2026 guidance, capital allocation plans and pathways to earnings and free cash flow per‑share growth.
Filed and posted September 2026 investor presentation under Regulation FD; slide deck available on the company website.
2026 guidance: Adjusted EBITDA $290.2M–$302.2M (alternative $310M–$320M range shown), Adjusted FFO $228.4M–$240.4M (alt $245.5M–$255.5M).
Adjusted FFO per share guidance of $1.10–$1.16 (alternative $1.18–$1.23); midpoint change noted as $0.075 in the presentation.
Capital plan: $75M–$85M of capital expenditures in 2026 and ongoing 7–9% of revenue annual reinvestment to support projects through 2030.
Strategy emphasizes margin expansion, capital recycling, third‑party management optionality and targeting AFFO/sh growth plus dividend yield above peers.
